ios.desc:
Need a little extra motivation to stay focused?
LockIn turns productivity into a social, motivating experience that actually helps you get things done.

Plan your tasks, lock into focus sessions, and stay accountable with others. Whether you’re studying, coding, creating, or tackling your daily to-dos, LockIn makes productivity feel less lonely — and way more rewarding.

Focus with intention

Set a focus timer and immerse yourself in beautifully designed focus rooms — from calming Zen gardens to cozy coffee shops and scenic beaches — and dive straight into deep work.

Lo-fi beats for deep focus

Choose from relaxing lo-fi tracks designed to help you stay calm, focused, and in the zone.

Plan & finish your to-dos

Create to-do lists and mark tasks as complete by uploading a photo as proof. Turn intentions into visible progress.

Share your progress

After each focus session or completed task, tag what you worked on, add a note, and share it on the Social Screen. See what others are working on, their focus hours, streaks, and stay inspired.

Unlock puzzle rewards

Every focus session earns puzzle pieces that slowly reveal stunning artwork. Keep focusing and watch the masterpiece come together.

Stay accountable together

Follow friends, check leaderboards, and see who’s putting in the work. It’s like Instagram — but for getting things done.

Track your productivity

View daily, weekly, and monthly focus trends, discover your most productive times, and build consistency over time.

Whether you’re trying to stay focused, finish your to-do list, or cut distractions, LockIn helps you plan less and finish more — together.

Download now and lock in.

quotes.text:
My friends and I were absolutely cooked during finals. We’d sit down to study, swear we’d focus… and somehow end up scrolling thru our phones, zoning out, or just procrastinating. We wanted to lock in, tick things off our to do list, and hold each other accountable so I built LocasFocus.

LocasFocus is a social focus timer that makes focusing fun. Set a timer, enter an immersive focus room, and get in the zone with lofi beats. After each focus session, share what you worked on, scroll the focus feed to see what your friends are focusing on for inspo, and compete on the leaderboard to see who’s racking up the most focus hours. Oh, and after every focus session, u unlock pieces of a puzzle to stunning images.

I hope you enjoy using it to stay focused.  Let me know what you think!
